description: PHP script for handling WPS configuration actions such as enabling/disabling WPS, setting WPS methods, pairing clients via push button or PIN, and canceling sessions. It interacts with device settings through setStr calls and includes utility functions.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates WPS PIN checksum for 4 or 8 digit PINs.

methods.name: MiniApplySSID
methods.description: Applies settings to a specific SSID based on its number.
